responsibility: Implements the graphviz_out helper class, a pretty-printer wrapper for structured GraphViz DOT generation. Its responsibility is low-level formatted emission with indentation and convenience routines for HTML-like table fragments used in node labels, so other GCC components can build readable .dot output without directly managing pretty_printer formatting and escaping boundaries.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation of the graphviz helper layer: it defines graphviz_out methods for formatted DOT emission, indentation, and HTML-like table tags. Unlike graphviz.h, which only declares the helper class, this file provides the low-level output behavior; unlike graph.cc, it does not know about GCC CFGs.
